description: Defines structures, constants, and types for disk block file format used in cache storage, including header structures, sparse data support, and file management details.

classes.name: BlockFileHeader
classes.description: Header structure for a block file, containing metadata such as magic number, version, file index, and allocation map.

classes.name: SparseHeader
classes.description: Control structure for sparse data entries, including signature, key length, and last block info.

classes.name: SparseData
classes.description: Contains SparseHeader and bitmap for managing sparse data blocks.
